entries.title: Psalms 16:1
segments: ¶<<A Michtam of David.>> Preserve me, O God, for in You I put my trust.

entries.title: Psalms 16:2
segments: [O my soul], you have said to the LORD, "You [are] my Lord, My goodness is nothing apart from You."

entries.title: Psalms 16:3
segments: As for the saints who [are] on the earth, "They are the excellent ones, in whom is all my delight."

entries.title: Psalms 16:4
segments: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who hasten [after] another [god]; Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, Nor take up their names on my lips.

entries.title: Psalms 16:5
segments: O LORD, [You are] the portion of my inheritance and my cup; You maintain my lot.

entries.title: Psalms 16:6
segments: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant [places]; Yes, I have a good inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 16:7
segments: I will bless the LORD who has given me counsel; My heart also instructs me in the night seasons.

entries.title: Psalms 16:8
segments: ¶I have set the LORD always before me; Because [He is] at my right hand I shall not be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 16:9
segments: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoices; My flesh also will rest in hope.

entries.title: Psalms 16:10
segments: For You will not leave my soul in Sheol, Nor will You allow Your Holy One to see corruption.

entries.title: Psalms 16:11
segments: You will show me the path of life; In Your presence [is] fullness of joy; At Your right hand [are] pleasures forevermore.
